name: Muhammad Ahmed Khan
shortBio: Two decades of experience in industrial supply chains, from plant procurement floors to nationwide distribution.
bio: Ahmed started on the buyer's side of the desk, running procurement for a large engineering group where a single delayed consignment could idle a production line for days. In 2009 he founded Ferrox with one rule that still governs the company: never promise a delivery date you would not bet your own line on.

Under his leadership Ferrox has grown from a two-person trading desk into a multi-category supplier serving more than 400 clients, with its own warehouse, QA documentation practices and a technical support team. He still personally reviews supplier qualifications for every new chemical and alloy line added to the catalog.
quote: Quality is not an act, it is a habit we supply every day.

experience.title: Founder & CEO
experience.description: Built a 1,500+ line multi-category catalog and a nationwide client base across textiles, pharma, food, construction and utilities.

experience.title: Senior Procurement Manager
experience.description: Managed annual procurement of chemicals, coatings and MTO items for three manufacturing plants.

experience.title: Procurement Engineer
experience.description: Sourced mechanical components and fasteners; introduced vendor rating system still used today.

name: Sara Malik
shortBio: Leads key accounts and export sales; the person clients call when they need a bulk quote yesterday.
bio: Sara has spent over a decade in B2B industrial sales and manages Ferrox's key accounts across textiles, food processing and water utilities. She coordinates annual supply contracts, scheduled deliveries and everything in between.
Known for quotes that arrive within hours — with the documentation attached the first time.

experience.title: Sales Manager
experience.description: Grew the key-account portfolio from 40 to 180+ clients and launched export sales to the Gulf.

name: Usman Tariq
shortBio: Chemical engineer who helps clients spec the right grade, coating or component for the job.
bio: Usman heads Ferrox's technical desk, translating plant requirements into exact specifications — from equivalent-grade chemical substitutions to coating systems for high-temperature service.
If a datasheet, MSDS or compatibility chart can settle an argument, Usman has already sent it to you.

experience.title: Technical Support Lead
experience.description: Built the technical documentation library and supports 300+ specification queries a year.
